subject: prd/implement-now
statement: For identical frozen or translated demand, selected harness, implementation role, effective mapping policy, and qualification evidence, routing resolution shall return one identical least-cost exact/promoted/unsupported result using zero model inference and zero network I/O. Until the coordinated parent append-first policy is effective, the compatibility path shall retain the existing zero-network pre-claim boundary. Once that parent policy is effective, after every terminal result exists and before task claim or selected worker invocation, the executor shall durably append that terminal to the configured canonical git evidence store and exact-read it successfully. The append and exact-read are then the only network operations permitted in that interval: no policy lookup, qualification lookup, harness probe, model call, or other outbound operation may occur.
fit_criterion: repeated and reordered-input fixtures are byte-identical; exhaustive candidate-order tests select the same cheapest qualified dominating result; dependency inspection and boundary traces record zero inference/network I/O through resolution and prove the pre-parent compatibility path remains zero-network; after parent activation every healthy-path trace contains a successful canonical append and exact-read before claim or invocation and no other network operation; a zero-evidence healthy path fails, and unavailable or unverifiable evidence produces zero claim and zero worker invocation
